observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Canon DSLR camera with 'Canon' logo and 'EOS 650D' visible on the top right. The lens has 'Canon' and focal length markings (18-55mm).
Photo 1: Back view showing the LCD screen, control buttons (MENU, INFO, WB, SET, AF), and the rear grip. The camera appears to be in good condition with no visible damage.
Photo 2: Top view showing the mode dial, shutter count indicator, and lens. The lens has '18 24 35 55' visible. The camera body shows no obvious dents or scratches.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.claim: Clean and Sharp UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera With 18 - 55MM Lens Working perfectly ok
claims.evidence: Photos show the camera and lens in good physical condition, but no proof of functionality (e.g., shutter count, lens focus, image quality). The 'UK Used' claim cannot be verified remotely.
The claim is cut off; no further text or context is provided to verify or contradict.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, lens not working, screen not responding)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a clear image on the screen.

risks.risk: Shutter count may be high (e.g., over 10,000 shots), indicating heavy use
risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count display on the camera body (usually on the top or back) or a screenshot from a shutter count tool.

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, scratches, or internal damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass (front and back) under bright light, or a video showing lens focus and image quality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential internal damage

risks.risk: Camera may have water damage or internal faults not visible externally
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's serial number and model number on the bottom (if any), or a video showing the camera's menu and settings.

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera powering on and taking a photo with a clear image on the screen.
Photo of the shutter count display on the camera body.
Close-up photo of the lens glass (front and back) under bright light.
Photo of the camera's serial number and model number on the bottom (if any).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
